title: hepatica triloba var. acutiloba
intro: Hepatica triloba var. acutiloba, commonly known as Sharp-lobed Hepatica, is a species of flowering plant in the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). This perennial plant is native to eastern Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The roots and leaves of Hepatica triloba var. acutiloba are rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been reported to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include reducing fever, alleviating cough and respiratory issues, and acting as a diuretic, while also providing potential protection against oxidative stress and cell damage.
